## 1. Acceptance and Applicability

These Terms govern business use of the OptCulture platform and related services ("**Services**").

By registering, subscribing, activating or using the Services after receiving clear notice of these Terms, you agree to be bound by them, to the extent permitted by law. Anyone accepting on behalf of a business confirms their authority to do so.

These Terms apply whether or not you have a Master Services Agreement ("**MSA**") with OptCulture. Where an MSA exists, it takes precedence. Otherwise, these Terms and the applicable Order Form form the agreement.

Your contracting entity, identified in your MSA, Order Form, subscription confirmation or invoice, will be one of the following:

- {{LIST:OptCultureEntities}}**{{country}}:** {{name}} ▲

The applicable entity is referred to as "**OptCulture**", "**we**" or "**us**".

▲ {{#IF IsPartner}}Where the Order Form is issued by an authorised local partner of OptCulture ("**Partner**"), here **{{EntityName}}**, the Partner is your contracting party for commercial matters (fees, invoicing and local support). References to "OptCulture" in Sections 6 and 8 include the Partner, and OptCulture operates the platform as the Partner's service provider.{{/IF IsPartner}}

## 2. Services and Access

OptCulture provides an AI-powered customer engagement and loyalty platform, including marketing automation, campaigns, customer data management, loyalty, analytics and related services.

Your subscription grants you a limited, non-exclusive right to use the subscribed Services for your business purposes.

You are responsible for securing your account and managing authorised users. You may not copy, resell, reverse engineer, misuse or interfere with the Services, except as permitted by law or written agreement.

We may improve, modify or replace features, provided material contracted functionality is not substantially reduced without appropriate notice or remedy.

## 3. Customer Responsibilities

You are responsible for your data, content, campaigns, communications and use of the Services.

You agree to comply with applicable laws, obtain necessary permissions and marketing consents, honour opt-out requests, and ensure your campaigns and promotions are lawful and accurate.

You must not use the Services for spam, fraud, misleading communications, unlawful content, infringement of third-party rights or activities that compromise security.

You are responsible for reviewing automated communications and AI-generated outputs as appropriate.

OptCulture may restrict or suspend activities that violate these Terms, applicable laws or third-party provider policies.

## 4. Data, Privacy and AI

You retain ownership of your data and content. You authorise OptCulture to process them as necessary to provide, maintain, secure and support the Services.

We will not sell Customer Data or use identifiable Customer Data for unrelated advertising without appropriate authorisation. Aggregated or de-identified operational information may be used to improve our Services and to produce anonymised industry benchmarks, subject to applicable law. ▲

Personal data processing is governed by our **Data Processing Agreement (DPA)**{{#IF HasDpaNo}} No. {{DpaNo}}{{/IF HasDpaNo}}.

AI-generated insights, recommendations and automated actions may be inaccurate or produce unexpected results. You are responsible for appropriate oversight and use of such outputs.

We will not use Customer Data to train general-purpose AI models for unrelated third parties without your express authorisation.

## 5. Service Availability and Third Parties

Service availability, support and maintenance commitments are set out in **Schedule 2, Service Level Terms**. ▲

OptCulture facilitates communications through channels such as SMS, email, push notifications, Rich Communication Services, WhatsApp and other third-party networks.

The Services may depend on third-party platforms, integrations and communication providers. OptCulture does not guarantee message delivery, uninterrupted third-party availability, AI accuracy or specific business results.

Beta or preview features may be modified or discontinued and are provided "as is", subject to applicable law and contractual obligations.

## 6. Fees, Renewal and Cancellation

Fees, billing periods and usage charges are governed by your Order Form{{#IF HasOrderFormNo}} No. {{OrderFormNo}}{{/IF HasOrderFormNo}}, subscription confirmation or agreed commercial arrangements. Subscription fees are payable irrespective of actual usage, unless otherwise agreed. Fees already paid are non-refundable, except as agreed or required by law.

Invoices are payable within {{PaymentDays}} days. Late payments attract interest at {{LateFeePct}} per month, or the maximum permitted by law if lower. ▲

**Subscriptions renew automatically** for successive periods equal to the current subscription term, unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least {{RenewalNoticeDays}} days before the end of the then-current term, or as otherwise agreed in the Order Form. ▲

## 7. Intellectual Property and Confidentiality

OptCulture owns the Platform, software, technology and related intellectual property. You retain ownership of your data and content.

Each party shall protect the other's confidential business and technical information, use it only for authorised purposes, and disclose it only as permitted or legally required.

Any applicable MSA or NDA governs additional confidentiality obligations.

## 8. Non-Solicitation ▲

During the subscription term and for **{{NonSolicitMonths}} months** after it ends, you shall not, directly or indirectly, solicit for employment, recruit, engage or retain any employee of OptCulture{{#IF IsPartner}} or of the Partner{{/IF IsPartner}} who was involved in providing the Services, without our prior written consent. This does not restrict general recruitment advertising not targeted at such employees. If this clause is breached, OptCulture may seek all remedies available under applicable law.

## 9. Suspension and Termination

OptCulture may suspend or restrict access to the Services for non-payment, violation of these Terms, unlawful activity, or security risks, with reasonable notice where practicable.

Termination rights, notice periods and related obligations are governed by the applicable MSA, Order Form or agreed subscription arrangements.

Upon termination, access to the Services shall cease, and outstanding payment obligations remain payable. Customer Data will be available for export for {{DataExportDays}} days and is otherwise handled in accordance with the DPA. ▲

## 10. Warranties, Indemnification and Liability

OptCulture will provide the Services with reasonable care and skill. Except for express contractual commitments, the Services are otherwise provided "as is" and "as available", without additional warranties to the extent permitted by law.

You agree to defend and indemnify OptCulture against third-party claims arising from your unlawful use of the Services, unlawful marketing communications, infringement by your content or failure to obtain required consents.

OptCulture will defend and indemnify you against third-party intellectual property claims arising from authorised use of the unmodified Platform, excluding claims caused by your content, modifications or unauthorised use. Each party must promptly notify and reasonably cooperate with the other regarding indemnified claims.

Neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential damages, including lost profits or business opportunities, to the extent permitted by law.

OptCulture's total aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid or payable during the preceding {{LiabilityCapMonths}} months, except for liabilities that cannot legally be limited. This does not limit payment obligations or liability for fraud or wilful misconduct.

## 11. General Terms

**Changes:** We may update these Terms with reasonable advance notice of material changes. Continued use after legally sufficient notice may constitute acceptance where permitted by law.

**Applicable Documents and Order of Precedence:** (1) the MSA, where applicable; (2) the DPA, for personal data processing; (3) the Order Form, for commercial arrangements; (4) these Terms, including Schedule 1 and Schedule 2. ▲

**Governing Law:** Governing law and dispute resolution are determined by the MSA or, where no MSA exists, **Schedule 1**. ▲

**Force Majeure:** Neither party is liable for delays caused by circumstances beyond reasonable control, except for payment obligations already due.

**Assignment:** You may not assign these Terms without our prior written consent. We may assign them to an affiliate or successor. ▲

**General:** If any provision is unenforceable, the remaining provisions remain effective. Accrued obligations and provisions intended to survive termination shall continue. No agency, partnership or joint venture is created. ▲

These Terms, together with the applicable incorporated documents and the Order Form, constitute the agreement between the parties unless superseded by an MSA.
